screening_models_scope_decision.reason: bisenetv2's screening run was interrupted by the owner mid-session (directed to stop it live, since it was ~6.5-7s/iter and would need ~8 more hours to reach the 6000-step ceiling, and it is already excluded from final_models regardless of its screening outcome). Resuming it would cost real deadline time for a result that cannot change the final-stage model set. Its partial real evidence (smoke-stage mIoU 6.57 at 50 iters; interrupted screening checkpoint at iter ~1500/6000) remains in the evidence record and is reported honestly as incomplete -- see docs/AI_USAGE_LOG.md for the full record. segformer_b0/fast_scnn/pidnet_s/ddrnet_23_slim already completed full 6000-step screening before this decision and are unaffected.

screening_models_scope_decision_2026_08_.reason: The automatic recovery-identity-migration tool (see docs/AI_USAGE_LOG.md) refused to migrate fast_scnn's real, complete 6000-step screening checkpoint (mIoU 20.10, recorded under project_commit f2f211000baf7a9f9139d777c8529fa6639c78de) to the current commit -- resuming it is now blocked, so it would retrain from scratch. Real pilot-stage throughput measured on both L4 (~5.2s/iter) and A100 (~5.3-5.6s/iter, no speedup observed for this model at the frozen device_batch=4 -- the workload appears CPU/dataloader-bound rather than GPU-compute-bound at this batch size) puts a fresh 6000-step run at ~9 GPU-hours. fast_scnn is already excluded from final_models (see the decision below) and its real screening evidence already exists and is preserved in the report with an explicit note -- rerunning it cannot change any downstream decision. Applying the exact same reasoning already used for bisenetv2's exclusion above.

final_models_scope_decision.reason: Real measured per-iteration screening throughput (semantic-cs-idd-v3, project_commit f2f211000baf7a9f9139d777c8529fa6639c78de) showed fast_scnn (~5.3s/iter) and bisenetv2 (~6.5-7s/iter) are 15-25x slower than segformer_b0/pidnet_s/ddrnet_23_slim; a full 40000-step final run on all five would cost ~155 GPU-hours, incompatible with the 4-day presentation deadline. fast_scnn and bisenetv2 real screening results (mIoU 20.10 and partial smoke-only 6.57 respectively) remain reported in the training-log analysis; see docs/AI_USAGE_LOG.md for the full evidence and decision record.
